pages.text: $(thing)Caress$() is the simplest and warmest quirk.$(br2)Its core mechanic can be summed up in one word — $(#FF69B4)cuddles$()! If you love intimate interactions with nekos, this quirk is made for you~

pages.title: Interaction Effects
pages.text: With the Caress quirk, $(#FF69B4)right-clicking another neko with an empty hand$() triggers:$(br2)$(li)$(#FF69B4)Heart particles$() appear around them — sweet and heartwarming$(li)Your $(thing)affection (XP)$() with that neko's owner will increase$(br2)A simple right-click — express your love AND strengthen your bonds at the same time!

pages.title: Use Cases
pages.text: The Caress quirk is especially great in these situations:$(br2)$(li)Just tamed a new neko and want to quickly build rapport$(li)Strolling through safe areas with your neko companion, cuddling as you go$(li)Multiple nekos gathered together — spread the love, right-click each one$(br2)$(#FFB6C1)Cuddles are great, but don't overdo it — you still have monsters to fight and adventures to go on!$()
